newsitem.title: USA: REITS, natural gas cited as industries of the week.
newsitem.headline: REITS, natural gas cited as industries of the week.

text.p: CS First Boston on Monday cited real estate investment trusts and natural gas as its industries of the week.
Analyst Mark Benson said that many of the postive fundamental and technical influences that drove the REIT industry in the second half of 1996 remain firmly in place and are accelerating.
"There is disciplined development, a self-correcting mechanism that has kept the rental markets at equilibrium," Benson stated.
"The perception of the risk of overbuilding has receded. There is not the fear of a repeat of the overbuilding of the 1980s," he said.
Benson said that institutional and retail investors have become more comfortable holding REIT shares and have increased their holdings of REITs.
He said that with high valuations in the broader markets, investors like the defensive characteristics of REITs, such as high dividend yields and high predictability of earnings.
Analyst Steve Parla said that he believes that virtually every local gas and electric company will merge over a long-time period.

"While the overwhelming majority of mergers are likely to be electric acquisitions of gas due to the size and financial strength of the electrics, some gas company acquisitions of strategic electric utilites remain possible," Parla said in a recent report.
